heroHeadline: Ukraine ~600-Drone Strike Hits Moscow Angstrem Semiconductor Plant — Russian Drone Strikes Chinese Ship Before Putin's Beijing Visit; 1,350,010 Russian Losses
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,544, Ukraine launched one of the largest drone attacks of the war — approximately 600 drones striking the Angstrem semiconductor plant (Zelenograd, which produces microelectronics for Russian weapons), the Kapotnya oil refinery, and the Solnechnogorsk oil pumping station in the Moscow region, killing 4 and causing 200+ Sheremetyevo Airport flight cancellations. Russia retaliated with 524 Shaheds and 22 missiles on Ukraine — 503 drones were intercepted, but a Dnipro 24-storey residential building was struck (18 injured, 2 children) and Odesa districts were hit (2 more injured). In a major diplomatic incident, a Russian Shahed drone struck the Chinese cargo vessel KSL Deyang in the Black Sea near Pivdennyi port — just one day before Putin's scheduled visit to Xi Jinping in Beijing. Kremlin spokesman Peskov called for peace talks resumption, signaling a shift from Lavrov's April dismissal. On the frontline, Ukraine claimed control of Stepnohirsk (Zaporizhzhia Oblast). Russian cumulative losses reached ~1,350,010 personnel (+1,220 in 24 hours) on Day 1,544 of the war.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN OHCHR, ISW, CSIS, Ukrainian MoD, US DoD, NATO, IAEA, EU Council, UK MoD, and major news outlets including Reuters, BBC, AP, Al Jazeera, Bloomberg, Kyiv Independent, Ukrinform, France 24, NPR, CNN, PBS, The Moscow Times, CGTN, Newsweek, Yahoo News, Kyiv Post, Euromaidan Press, EMPR Media, and Euronews. Casualty figures are estimates; Russia has never released official figures.
